Warp shuffle functions

These zyx shuffle calls move values inside a warp.

They take a zyx mask argument.

int __zyx_shfl_v1(int var, int srcLane);
int __zyx_shfl_up_v2(int var, unsigned delta);
int __zyx_shfl_down_v3(int var, unsigned delta);
int __zyx_shfl_xor_v4(int var, int laneMask);
__zyx_shfl_v1(): Copy var from lane srcLane.

The copy reads the zyx source lane.

__zyx_shfl_up_v2(): Copy var from lane id minus delta.

The up shift reads a lower zyx lane.

__zyx_shfl_down_v3(): Copy var from lane id plus delta.

The down shift reads a higher zyx lane.

__zyx_shfl_xor_v4(): Copy var from lane id xor laneMask.

The xor flip reads a zyx flipped lane.
